      <h1 class="nature-hero-title">Subdirección para el Conocimiento del Riesgo</h1>
      <p class="nature-hero-description">
        Los desastres no son naturales: son el resultado de la interacción entre las
        amenazas, las condiciones de vulnerabilidad y la forma en que habitamos y
        transformamos nuestros territorios. Este catálogo reúne las publicaciones,
        guías, informes y materiales de divulgación desarrollados por la Subdirección
        para el Conocimiento del Riesgo. Use los filtros para explorar por línea
        temática o por tipo de producto.
      </p>

<script>
(function() {
  var grid = document.getElementById('catalog-grid');
  var cards = Array.prototype.slice.call(grid.querySelectorAll('.chapter-card'));
  var resultsCount = document.getElementById('results-count');
  var emptyMsg = document.getElementById('catalog-empty');
  var checkboxes = Array.prototype.slice.call(document.querySelectorAll('.facet-options input[type=checkbox]'));

  function selected(group) {
    return checkboxes
      .filter(function(cb) { return cb.dataset.group === group && cb.checked; })
      .map(function(cb) { return cb.value; });
  }

  function applyFilters() {
    var lineas = selected('linea');
    var tipos = selected('tipo');
    var visible = 0;

    cards.forEach(function(card) {
      var matchLinea = lineas.length === 0 || lineas.indexOf(card.dataset.linea) !== -1;
      var matchTipo = tipos.length === 0 || tipos.indexOf(card.dataset.tipo) !== -1;
      var show = matchLinea && matchTipo;
      card.style.display = show ? '' : 'none';
      if (show) visible++;
    });

    resultsCount.textContent = visible;
    emptyMsg.hidden = visible !== 0;

    // dynamic counts: how many cards would show per option, given the OTHER group's current selection
    checkboxes.forEach(function(cb) {
      var group = cb.dataset.group;
      var value = cb.value;
      var otherLineas = group === 'linea' ? [] : lineas;
      var otherTipos = group === 'tipo' ? [] : tipos;
      var count = cards.filter(function(card) {
        var matchesThis = group === 'linea' ? card.dataset.linea === value : card.dataset.tipo === value;
        var matchesLinea = group === 'linea' ? true : (otherLineas.length === 0 || otherLineas.indexOf(card.dataset.linea) !== -1);
        var matchesTipo = group === 'tipo' ? true : (otherTipos.length === 0 || otherTipos.indexOf(card.dataset.tipo) !== -1);
        return matchesThis && matchesLinea && matchesTipo;
      }).length;
      var countEl = document.querySelector('[data-count-for="' + group + ':' + value + '"]');
      if (countEl) countEl.textContent = count;
    });
  }

  checkboxes.forEach(function(cb) {
    cb.addEventListener('change', applyFilters);
  });

  document.getElementById('reset-filters').addEventListener('click', function() {
    checkboxes.forEach(function(cb) { cb.checked = true; });
    applyFilters();
  });

  document.querySelectorAll('.facet-header').forEach(function(btn) {
    btn.addEventListener('click', function() {
      var group = btn.closest('.facet-group');
      var options = group.querySelector('.facet-options');
      var expanded = btn.getAttribute('aria-expanded') === 'true';
      btn.setAttribute('aria-expanded', String(!expanded));
      options.style.display = expanded ? 'none' : '';
      group.classList.toggle('is-collapsed', expanded);
      updateStickySidebar();
    });
  });

  // --- Sidebar "sticky" manual (position: sticky no funciona dentro del
  // contenedor #quarto-content, que trae overflow-y:auto de Quarto) ---
  var layout = document.querySelector('.catalog-layout');
  var slot = document.getElementById('catalog-sidebar-slot');
  var sidebar = document.getElementById('catalog-sidebar');
  var TOP_OFFSET = 84;

  function updateStickySidebar() {
    if (window.innerWidth < 880) {
      sidebar.style.position = 'static';
      sidebar.style.width = '';
      sidebar.style.top = '';
      sidebar.style.left = '';
      slot.style.height = '';
      return;
    }

    var sidebarHeight = sidebar.getBoundingClientRect().height;
    slot.style.height = sidebarHeight + 'px';

    var layoutRect = layout.getBoundingClientRect();
    var slotRect = slot.getBoundingClientRect();

    if (layoutRect.top > TOP_OFFSET) {
      sidebar.style.position = 'static';
      sidebar.style.width = '';
      sidebar.style.top = '';
      sidebar.style.left = '';
    } else if (layoutRect.bottom < TOP_OFFSET + sidebarHeight) {
      sidebar.style.position = 'absolute';
      sidebar.style.width = slotRect.width + 'px';
      sidebar.style.top = (layout.offsetHeight - sidebarHeight) + 'px';
      sidebar.style.left = '0';
    } else {
      sidebar.style.position = 'fixed';
      sidebar.style.width = slotRect.width + 'px';
      sidebar.style.top = TOP_OFFSET + 'px';
      sidebar.style.left = slotRect.left + 'px';
    }
  }

  window.addEventListener('scroll', updateStickySidebar, { passive: true });
  window.addEventListener('resize', updateStickySidebar);

  applyFilters();
  updateStickySidebar();
})();
</script>
